scope:
Bounded guarded checker for all-internal scheduler iteration and fair candidate reach.

Only the supplied reviewed EnumeratorRun source and audit are freshly checked.
Explicit successful scheduler-step and append-execution records supply the
26 project providers. Cached external dependencies are reused; no build/fetch.

dependencies.discovery: read-only lake-manifest.json and existing .lake build directories; no Lake process
dependencies.cache_provenance: Existing built checkout is supplied by the caller; the checker records object identities but does not rebuild or independently attest the whole dependency cache.
